info.name: The News All News Headlines API

params.name: locale
params.description: Comma-separated list of country codes to filter by (e.g., us,ca,gb).

params.name: language
params.description: Comma-separated list of language codes to filter by (e.g., en,es,fr).

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma-separated list of categories: general, science, sports, business, health, entertainment, tech, politics, food, travel.

params.name: domains
params.description: Comma-separated list of domains to include.

params.name: exclude_domains
params.description: Comma-separated list of domains to exclude.

params.name: source_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of source IDs to include.

params.name: exclude_source_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of source IDs to exclude.

params.name: published_on
params.description: Filter to articles published on a specific date (Y-m-d format).

params.name: headlines_per_category
params.description: Number of articles per category (max 10, default 6).

params.name: include_similar
params.description: Include similar articles in the response (default true).

items.docs: Retrieve the latest headlines organized by category. Available on Standard plan and above. Returns articles grouped by category with optional similar article suggestions.
